## actions-agents

L neyvia-core v1 -- agents: exact agent actions
T t1{limits:json:"{\"type\":\"array\"}" providers:json:"{\"type\":\"array\"}" refreshing:bool refreshSeconds:num ..}
T t2{sessions:json:"{\"type\":\"array\"}" limits:json:"{\"type\":\"array\"}" sources:json:"{\"type\":\"array\"}" ..}
A neyvia.agents.limits(refresh?:bool wait?:bool) -> t1 -- Refresh Claude /usage and Codex account/rateLimits/read without a model turn; retain last-known values with timestamps and availability; OpenCode unsupported quota stays unavailable
F verify-agents-limits "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.agents.limits" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.agents.limits
A neyvia.agents.state(limit?:1..100 offset?:0..) -> t2 -- Read a page of every observed active-session dashboard row, checklists, subagents, reported limits/tokens and declared evidence sources; total counts active rows and nextOffset reaches remaining rows
F verify-agents-state "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.agents.state" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.agents.state
F A listed action is a registered capability, not proof of runtime availability. CL refuses unmapped mutations; use its owning manual and fresh effects. MCP adapters retain their own exposed scope.

## actions-app-sdk

L neyvia-core v1 -- app_sdk: exact agent actions
T t1 json:"{\"type\":\"object\"}"

T t4 [json:"{\"type\":\"object\"}"]
T t5{ok:true ..}
A neyvia.app_sdk.action(project:str url:str name:str arguments?:t1 clSource?:str native?:t1) -> t1 ! -- Apply a typed app action through its exact running reducer using T18; the same shared state updates the user UI.
F verify-app_sdk-action "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.app_sdk.action" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.app_sdk.action
A neyvia.app_sdk.build(project:str platform:t2) -> t1 ! -- Build an SDK app using installed local tools. Offline web builds carry source hashes; unavailable native toolchains are reported, never installed.
F verify-app_sdk-build "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.app_sdk.build" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.app_sdk.build
A neyvia.app_sdk.describe(project:str) -> t1 -- Read an SDK app's manual, platforms and current build/verification receipts.
F verify-app_sdk-describe "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.app_sdk.describe" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.app_sdk.describe
A neyvia.app_sdk.new(path:str name:str kind:t3) -> t1 ! -- Generate an app with a CL 1.1 manual, shared user/agent state and executable running-app goals. Does not install dependencies.
F verify-app_sdk-new "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.app_sdk.new" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.app_sdk.new
A neyvia.app_sdk.preview(project:str device?:str port:1..65535) -> t1 ! -- Open an SDK app in Mobile Studio's existing phone frame. port is the explicit running Neyvia backend port.
F verify-app_sdk-preview "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.app_sdk.preview" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.app_sdk.preview
A neyvia.app_sdk.state(project:str) -> t1 -- Read the app's persisted shared state; the user UI and agents use this exact store.
F verify-app_sdk-state "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.app_sdk.state" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.app_sdk.state
A neyvia.app_sdk.toolchain(platform:"android"|"ios" project?:str) -> t1 -- Observe the exact native build owner toolchain without starting adb, an emulator or downloads
F verify-app_sdk-toolchain "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.app_sdk.toolchain" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.app_sdk.toolchain
A neyvia.app_sdk.verify(project:str url:str clSource?:str native?:t1 steps?:t4) -> t5 ! -- Run the app's goals through T18 web perception and optional T16 native inspection; failed goals refuse completion. Uses an explicit running-app URL.
F verify-app_sdk-verify "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.app_sdk.verify" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.app_sdk.verify
F A listed action is a registered capability, not proof of runtime availability. CL refuses unmapped mutations; use its owning manual and fresh effects. MCP adapters retain their own exposed scope.

## actions-claude
CL 1
L neyvia-core v1 -- claude: exact agent actions
T t1 json:"{\"type\":\"object\"}"
A neyvia.claude.mods(enabled?:bool) -> t1 ! -- Persist the selected workspace plugin launch setting and read it back
F verify-claude-mods "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.claude.mods" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.claude.mods
A neyvia.claude.runs(session?:str limit?:1..40) -> t1 -- Read what Claude Code sessions running the Neyvia plugin reported: state, checklist, edited files.
F verify-claude-runs "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.claude.runs" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.claude.runs
F A listed action is a registered capability, not proof of runtime availability. CL refuses unmapped mutations; use its owning manual and fresh effects. MCP adapters retain their own exposed scope.
M neyvia-core "neyvia.claude.mods: Authority=none." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia-core "neyvia.claude.runs: Authority=none." src:"authored manual" state:verified

-- @proof {"checkedAt":["neyvia_conversations.NeyviaConversationStore.delete_conversation -> proofs_d_neyvia.conversation_delete","proofs_d_neyvia.self_check"],"claim":"Soft deletion retains its timestamped tombstone and removes active context and search entries within the transaction.","id":"neyvia-core.conversation-deletion","impact":["account devices and sessions"],"phase":"post"}

-- @proof {"checkedAt":["neyvia_agent_cli.main/neyvia_agent.main -> proofs_d_neyvia.agent_version","proofs_d_neyvia.self_check"],"claim":"The lightweight CLI and full parser expose one readable canonical product/version line without requiring a task; the lightweight path avoids loading the agent SDK.","id":"neyvia-core.agent-version","impact":["account devices and sessions"],"phase":"post"}
-- @proof {"checkedAt":["neyvia_application_contract._module_to_manifest -> proofs_d_neyvia.check_projection","proofs_d_neyvia.self_check"],"claim":"Only active application projections bind browser-loadable relative, HTTPS or local HTTP entrypoints; inactive and file URL projections have no hosted endpoint.","id":"neyvia-core.hosted-entrypoint","impact":["account devices and sessions"],"phase":"post"}
-- @proof {"checkedAt":["neyvia_mobile_studio.project_info -> proofs_d_neyvia.mobile_project","proofs_d_neyvia.self_check"],"claim":"Mobile project discovery retains configured app identity and selects the first existing export in the declared priority, including Capacitor and Expo metadata.","id":"neyvia-core.mobile-project","impact":["account devices and sessions"],"phase":"post"}
-- @proof {"checkedAt":["neyvia_mobile_studio._inject/_scheme -> proofs_d_neyvia.mobile_inject/mobile_scheme","proofs_d_neyvia.self_check"],"claim":"Mobile preview injects script-safe configuration before application code, answers dark/light and safe-area queries, and confines root asset references to its capability base.","id":"neyvia-core.mobile-injection","impact":["account devices and sessions"],"phase":"post"}
-- @proof {"checkedAt":["neyvia_mobile_studio.serve_preview/_send -> proofs_d_neyvia.mobile_target/mobile_sandbox","proofs_d_neyvia.self_check"],"claim":"Preview requests remain inside the project export capability; traversal fails, SPA fallback serves only extensionless paths and the opaque sandbox never grants same-origin authority.","id":"neyvia-core.mobile-confinement","impact":["account devices and sessions"],"phase":"invariant"}
-- @proof {"checkedAt":["neyvia_mobile_studio.serve_preview -> proofs_d_neyvia.mobile_storage_body/mobile_storage_saved","proofs_d_neyvia.self_check"],"claim":"Preview storage accepts only bounded JSON string maps, rejects malformed requests without writes and returns the durably persisted project map.","id":"neyvia-core.mobile-storage","impact":["account devices and sessions"],"phase":"invariant"}

## actions-devices
CL 1
L neyvia-core v1 -- devices: exact agent actions
T t1{transfer:{id:str status:str sha256:str device:str from:str to:str size:int done:int ..} ..}
T t2 json:"{\"type\":\"object\"}"
A neyvia.devices.files.fetch(device:str from:str to?:str wait?:num) -> t1 ! -- Create destination folder if missing and start chunk-verified Take; collision gets unique path; wait may return unfinished; use transfer.to
F verify-devices-files-fetch "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.devices.files.fetch" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.devices.files.fetch
A neyvia.devices.files.list(device:str path?:str showHidden?:bool) -> t2 -- Read remote places or folder entries (max 2000); refresh advertised theyShare when returned
F verify-devices-files-list "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.devices.files.list" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.devices.files.list
A neyvia.devices.files.read(device:str path:str offset?:int length?:int) -> t2 -- Read bounded remote bytes, UTF-8 text or base64, size/eof; no local copy
F verify-devices-files-read "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.devices.files.read" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.devices.files.read
A neyvia.devices.files.send(device:str from:str to?:str wait?:num) -> t1 ! -- Start chunk/hash-verified Send without overwrite; wait may return pending; transfer.to is actual received path
F verify-devices-files-send "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.devices.files.send" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.devices.files.send
A neyvia.devices.files.stat(device:str path:str preview?:bool hash?:bool) -> t2 -- Read remote kind/size/mime, optional 64 KiB text preview and SHA-256
F verify-devices-files-stat "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.devices.files.stat" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.devices.files.stat
A neyvia.devices.list() -> t2 -- Read saved PCs/requests/newest 30 transfers and cached tailnet status; online may be stale
F verify-devices-list "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.devices.list" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.devices.list
A neyvia.devices.transfers(id?:str) -> t2 -- Read newest 30 matching transfers with progress/status/error and end-to-end SHA-256
F verify-devices-transfers "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.devices.transfers" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.devices.transfers
F A listed action is a registered capability, not proof of runtime availability. CL refuses unmapped mutations; use its owning manual and fresh effects. MCP adapters retain their own exposed scope.

T t6{state:str engine:str enabled:bool ..}

T t8 json:"{\"type\":\"object\"}"

A neyvia.dictation.process(text:str history?:t4 final?:bool) -> t5 -- Same prompt policy as live dictation: cleaned text, ordered segments (text / command op), language, route, name fixes. Never sends or edits anything

F verify-dictation-transcribe "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.dictation.transcribe" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.dictation.transcribe

F verify-efficiency-transitions "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.efficiency.transitions" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.efficiency.transitions
F A listed action is a registered capability, not proof of runtime availability. CL refuses unmapped mutations; use its owning manual and fresh effects. MCP adapters retain their own exposed scope.

## actions-experience
CL 1
L neyvia-core v1 -- experience: exact agent actions
T t1 json:"{\"type\":\"string\",\"enum\":[\"user\",\"provisional\",\"undecided\"]}"
T t2 json:"{\"type\":\"object\"}"
T t3 json:"{\"type\":\"array\"}"
T t4 [str]
T t5 json:"{\"type\":\"string\",\"enum\":[\"input\",\"frame\",\"state\",\"error\",\"timing\"]}"
A experience.compare(workId:str baseline:str candidate:str preference:t1 observations?:t2) -> t2 ! -- Persist an exact proposed record, frozen criterion measurement, compiled plan or isolated byte copy
F verify-experience-compare "No authored observer check is bound to experience.compare" -> ask operator blocks:experience.compare
A experience.investigate(workId:str hypothesis:str experiment:t2 references?:t3) -> t2 ! -- Persist an exact proposed record, frozen criterion measurement, compiled plan or isolated byte copy
F verify-experience-investigate "No authored observer check is bound to experience.investigate" -> ask operator blocks:experience.investigate
A experience.note(workId:str lesson:str conditions:str invalidation:str evidence:t4) -> t2 ! -- Persist an exact proposed record, frozen criterion measurement, compiled plan or isolated byte copy

A host.launch(executable:str arguments?:t2 timeoutSeconds?:1..86400) -> t1 ! -- Fresh exact kernel process and owner state or independently observed requested file bytes
F verify-host-launch "No authored observer check is bound to host.launch" -> ask operator blocks:host.launch

F verify-host-prepare_file "No authored observer check is bound to host.prepare_file" -> ask operator blocks:host.prepare_file
A host.programs() -> t1 -- Discover existing host executables without installing anything.
F verify-host-programs "No authored observer check is bound to host.programs" -> ask operator blocks:host.programs

F verify-host-sessions "No authored observer check is bound to host.sessions" -> ask operator blocks:host.sessions

F verify-host-status "No authored observer check is bound to host.status" -> ask operator blocks:host.status
A host.stop(sessionId:str expectedRevision?:0..) -> t1 ! -- Fresh exact kernel process and owner state or independently observed requested file bytes
F verify-host-stop "No authored observer check is bound to host.stop" -> ask operator blocks:host.stop
F A listed action is a registered capability, not proof of runtime availability. CL refuses unmapped mutations; use its owning manual and fresh effects. MCP adapters retain their own exposed scope.

A image.inspect_asset(path:str) -> t1 -- Inspect actual image dimensions, alpha, format and SHA-256 inside this workspace.
F verify-image-inspect_asset "No authored observer check is bound to image.inspect_asset" -> ask operator blocks:image.inspect_asset
A neyvia.image.composite(edit:str region:t2) -> t1 ! -- Composite edit into region, verify outside pixels unchanged, publish new PNG and parent hash
F verify-image-composite "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.image.composite" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.image.composite
A neyvia.image.crop(region:t2) -> t1 ! -- Write cropped PNG artifact, publish it as requested asset, retain parentSha256
F verify-image-crop "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.image.crop" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.image.crop
A neyvia.image.export(path:str) -> t1 ! -- Exclusively copy exact asset bytes to new file and verify SHA-256; parent-directory approval covers new exports
F verify-image-export "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.image.export" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.image.export
A neyvia.image.generate(requestId:str request:t1) -> t1 ! -- Start one provider request asynchronously; exact ID retries return receipt, different payload refused; success publishes asset
F verify-image-generate "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.image.generate" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.image.generate
A neyvia.image.open(source:str) -> t1 -- Inspect pixels/hash, register asset and emit image.open; source unchanged and uiVerified=false
F verify-image-open "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.image.open" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.image.open
A neyvia.image.resize(width:1.. height:1..) -> t1 ! -- Write LANCZOS-resized PNG and publish new requested asset; source unchanged
F verify-image-resize "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.image.resize" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.image.resize
A neyvia.image.state() -> t3 -- Read observed state, requested asset and generation receipts; abandoned running generation is reported uncertain
F verify-image-state "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.image.state" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.image.state

T t1{question_id:str answer:str#..4000 checks:json:"{\"type\":\"array\",\"minItems\":1,\"maxItems\":12,\"uniqueItems\":true,\"items\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"description\":\"IDs of already saved artifact obligations; do not invent check results.\"}" expected_revision:0..}
T t2 json:"{\"type\":\"object\"}"
T t3{question:str#1..1200 decision:str#1..1200}
T t4{understanding:str#1..6000 expected_revision:json:"{\"type\":\"integer\",\"minimum\":0,\"description\":\"Current brief.revision, or 0 before first save. The top-level revision belongs to preferences.\"}" assumptions?:[str#..1000]#..12 directions?:json:"{\"type\":\"array\",\"maxItems\":4,\"items\":{\"type\":\"object\",\"additionalProperties\":false,\"properties\":{\"id\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"minLength\":1,\"maxLength\":120},\"title\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"minLength\":1,\"maxLength\":120},\"approach\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"minLength\":1,\"maxLength\":1500},\"tradeoff\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"minLength\":1,\"maxLength\":1500}},\"required\":[\"id\",\"title\",\"approach\",\"tradeoff\"]},\"description\":\"Omit to preserve the saved choices. Selected direction content must remain unchanged.\"}" open_questions?:[str#..1000]#..12}
T t5 json:"{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{},\"additionalProperties\":false}"
A intelligence.answer_self(workId:str arguments:t1) -> t2 ! -- Record your answer against existing artifact obligation IDs, checking their current evidence. Failed or stale checks keep the question unresolved. Use its exact expected_revision. Arguments: question_id, answer, checks, expected_revision.
F verify-intelligence-answer_self "No authored observer check is bound to intelligence.answer_self" -> ask operator blocks:intelligence.answer_self
A intelligence.ask_self(workId:str arguments:t3) -> t2 ! -- Record a concrete unresolved question and the decision it changes. This does not call another model or request user input. Arguments: question, decision.
F verify-intelligence-ask_self "No authored observer check is bound to intelligence.ask_self" -> ask operator blocks:intelligence.ask_self
A intelligence.brief(workId:str arguments:t4) -> t2 ! -- Save or revise the task brief. Use expected_revision from intelligence.collaboration.brief.revision (0 when no brief), not the preferences revision. Omitted lists retain their saved values; user corrections and the selected direction are protected. Arguments: understanding.
F verify-intelligence-brief "No authored observer check is bound to intelligence.brief" -> ask operator blocks:intelligence.brief
A intelligence.check(workId:str arguments:t2) -> t2 -- Recheck saved artifact obligations and report failures. Arguments: .
F verify-intelligence-check "No authored observer check is bound to intelligence.check" -> ask operator blocks:intelligence.check
A intelligence.collaboration(workId:str arguments:t5) -> t2 -- Read this task's collaboration preferences and evolving brief. Model proposals confer no authority. Arguments: .
F verify-intelligence-collaboration "No authored observer check is bound to intelligence.collaboration" -> ask operator blocks:intelligence.collaboration
A intelligence.handoff(workId:str arguments:t2) -> t2 ! -- Persist an immutable handoff with objective, protected decision IDs, answer key and artifact identities. Arguments: objective, protected_decisions, answers.
F verify-intelligence-handoff "No authored observer check is bound to intelligence.handoff" -> ask operator blocks:intelligence.handoff
A intelligence.obligate(workId:str arguments:t2) -> t2 ! -- Attach a runnable file_contains or json_path criterion to a real artifact hash. Arguments: artifact, sha256, criterion.
F verify-intelligence-obligate "No authored observer check is bound to intelligence.obligate" -> ask operator blocks:intelligence.obligate
A intelligence.rationale(workId:str arguments:t2) -> t2 ! -- Save a versioned purpose and protected decisions for an element. Arguments: element_id, purpose.
F verify-intelligence-rationale "No authored observer check is bound to intelligence.rationale" -> ask operator blocks:intelligence.rationale
A intelligence.read(workId:str arguments:t2) -> t2 -- Read durable rationale and obligations. Arguments: .
F verify-intelligence-read "No authored observer check is bound to intelligence.read" -> ask operator blocks:intelligence.read
A intelligence.resume(workId:str arguments:t2) -> t2 -- Reconstruct a saved handoff by ID and verify objective, answers and current artifacts. Arguments: handoff, objective, answers.
F verify-intelligence-resume "No authored observer check is bound to intelligence.resume" -> ask operator blocks:intelligence.resume
A intelligence.self_questions(workId:str arguments:t2) -> t2 -- Retrieve bounded self-questions, reported answers and stale evidence; no claim about hidden model thinking. Arguments: .
F verify-intelligence-self_questions "No authored observer check is bound to intelligence.self_questions" -> ask operator blocks:intelligence.self_questions

L neyvia-core v1 -- lab: exact agent actions
T t1 json:"{\"type\":\"object\"}"
T t2 json:"{\"type\":\"object\",\"minProperties\":2,\"maxProperties\":8,\"additionalProperties\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"minLength\":1,\"maxLength\":4096}}"
T t3 json:"{\"type\":\"array\",\"minItems\":2,\"maxItems\":8,\"uniqueItems\":true,\"items\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"minLength\":1,\"maxLength\":120}}"
T t4 json:"{\"type\":\"array\",\"minItems\":1,\"maxItems\":12,\"uniqueItems\":true,\"items\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"minLength\":1,\"maxLength\":120}}"
T t5 json:"{\"type\":\"array\"}"
T t6{kind:json:"{\"type\":\"string\",\"enum\":[\"json_numeric\",\"image\",\"trace_timing\"]}" key?:str#1.. max?:num maxMeanMs?:json:"{\"type\":\"number\",\"minimum\":0}" minWidth?:0.. minHeight?:0.. maxBytes?:0..}
T t7{records:json:"{\"type\":\"array\"}" competitions:json:"{\"type\":\"array\"}" automaticTraining:false automaticPromotion:false ..}
A lab.causal(baseline:str variant:str factor:str workId:str) -> t1 ! -- Compare reported trials only when one declared factor changes; expose confounded comparisons
F verify-lab-causal "No authored observer check is bound to lab.causal" -> ask operator blocks:lab.causal
A lab.compare(identity:str targets:t2 workId:str) -> t1 ! -- Freeze isolated candidates, measure all candidates against identical criteria, or archive older context without losing original evidence
F verify-lab-compare "No authored observer check is bound to lab.compare" -> ask operator blocks:lab.compare
A lab.competition(identity:str source:str candidates:t3 instruments:t4 workId:str) -> t1 ! -- Freeze isolated candidates, measure all candidates against identical criteria, or archive older context without losing original evidence
F verify-lab-competition "No authored observer check is bound to lab.competition" -> ask operator blocks:lab.competition
A lab.complexity() -> t1 -- Inspect duplicate contracts and absent observations; never remove tools from absence alone
F verify-lab-complexity "No authored observer check is bound to lab.complexity" -> ask operator blocks:lab.complexity
A lab.curriculum(identity:str examples:t5) -> t1 ! -- Freeze training and holdout evidence; reject duplicate content and task-family leakage
F verify-lab-curriculum "No authored observer check is bound to lab.curriculum" -> ask operator blocks:lab.curriculum
A lab.instrument(identity:str spec:t6) -> t1 ! -- Freeze isolated candidates, measure all candidates against identical criteria, or archive older context without losing original evidence
F verify-lab-instrument "No authored observer check is bound to lab.instrument" -> ask operator blocks:lab.instrument
A lab.journey(path:str) -> t1 ! -- Analyze a timestamped interaction trace for delay, unanswered actions, errors and continuity events
F verify-lab-journey "No authored observer check is bound to lab.journey" -> ask operator blocks:lab.journey
A lab.lesson_packet(identity:str) -> t1 -- Retrieve hash-checked training examples without including held-out content
F verify-lab-lesson_packet "No authored observer check is bound to lab.lesson_packet" -> ask operator blocks:lab.lesson_packet
A lab.next_experiment(identity:str) -> t1 -- Prioritize unmeasured or stale assumptions and preserve failed observations
F verify-lab-next_experiment "No authored observer check is bound to lab.next_experiment" -> ask operator blocks:lab.next_experiment
A lab.rehearse(experiment_id:str script:str workId:str) -> t1 ! -- Run an existing snapshot script with installed software in a managed session; host access remains
F verify-lab-rehearse "No authored observer check is bound to lab.rehearse" -> ask operator blocks:lab.rehearse
A lab.resolve_uncertainty(identity:str assumption:int instrument:str target:str) -> t1 ! -- Attach a real frozen-instrument measurement to an assumption without promoting its semantic claim

L neyvia-core v1 -- onboarding: exact agent actions

T t4 json:"{\"type\":\"string\",\"enum\":[\"status\",\"install\"]}"
T t5 [str]
T t6{state:{completed:bool interests:json:"{\"type\":\"array\"}" apps:json:"{\"type\":\"array\"}" packs:json:"{\"type\":\"array\"}" tier:str ..} ..}
A neyvia.onboarding.base_pack(action?:t1) -> t2 -- Read status, resume detached downloader or request pause; checksum-verified bytes staged locally
F verify-onboarding-base_pack "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.onboarding.base_pack" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.onboarding.base_pack
A neyvia.onboarding.open(step?:t3) -> t2 -- Fresh real mounted DOM, exact delivered event, runtime and requested state; notes conserve body bytes
F verify-onboarding-open "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.onboarding.open" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.onboarding.open
A neyvia.onboarding.pack(action?:t4 packId?:str) -> t2 ! -- Read pack statuses or stage verified add-on in detached worker; no system install or activation
F verify-onboarding-pack "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.onboarding.pack" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.onboarding.pack
A neyvia.onboarding.recommend(interests?:t5 tier?:str) -> t2 -- Compute recommended apps/packs/tour chapters; save nothing
F verify-onboarding-recommend "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.onboarding.recommend" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.onboarding.recommend
A neyvia.onboarding.runtimes() -> t2 -- Detect local CLI availability and return setup steps; does not install runtimes
F verify-onboarding-runtimes "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.onboarding.runtimes" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.onboarding.runtimes
A neyvia.onboarding.save(interests?:t5 tier?:str apps?:t5 packs?:t5 runtime?:str completed?:bool) -> t2 -- Merge supplied fields into persistent setup state; omitted choices retained
F verify-onboarding-save "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.onboarding.save" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.onboarding.save
A neyvia.onboarding.state() -> t6 -- Return persisted setup choices, catalog, tour and base-pack status
F verify-onboarding-state "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.onboarding.state" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.onboarding.state
F A listed action is a registered capability, not proof of runtime availability. CL refuses unmapped mutations; use its owning manual and fresh effects. MCP adapters retain their own exposed scope.

L neyvia-core v1 -- perception: exact agent actions

A neyvia.perception.browser.action(browserId:str revision:str element:str action:"fill"|"click" value?:str) -> t1 ! -- Act on a fresh DOM projection; stale revisions fail before any effect. Caller must authorize the action.
F verify-perception-browser-action "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.perception.browser.action" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.perception.browser.action
A neyvia.perception.browser.close(browserId:str) -> t1 ! -- Close this owned browser session.

A neyvia.perception.browser.observe(browserId?:str) -> t1 -- Read the current DOM of the sole owned private browser session; refuse an ambiguous selection.
F verify-perception-browser-observe "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.perception.browser.observe" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.perception.browser.observe
A neyvia.perception.browser.open(url:str) -> t1 ! -- Open a private browser session for exactly this origin; no user profile or downloads.
F verify-perception-browser-open "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.perception.browser.open" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.perception.browser.open
A neyvia.perception.check(handle:str path:str equals:any) -> t1 -- Check an observed handle, not unobserved live state; refresh first for postconditions.
F verify-perception-check "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.perception.check" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.perception.check
A neyvia.perception.observe(layer:t2 source:t3 stream?:str previousHandle?:str reset?:bool) -> t4 -- Neyvia bus and bot-side application state; durable handle or JSON Patch diff
F verify-perception-observe "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.perception.observe" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.perception.observe
A neyvia.perception.project(handle:str path?:str offset?:0.. limit?:1..100) -> t1 -- Selected text state, never pixels
F verify-perception-project "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.perception.project" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.perception.project
F A listed action is a registered capability, not proof of runtime availability. CL refuses unmapped mutations; use its owning manual and fresh effects. MCP adapters retain their own exposed scope.

T t4{path:str width:int height:int ..}
T t5 [json:"{\"type\":\"string\",\"enum\":[\"desktop\",\"phone\"]}"]
T t6 json:"{\"type\":\"string\",\"enum\":[\"dark\",\"light\"]}"
T t7 json:"{\"type\":\"boolean\",\"description\":\"Inline capped screenshots for the installed desktop Preview, which has no HTTP artifact route.\"}"
T t8 json:"{\"type\":\"object\",\"description\":\"Controls to exercise through Laya: actions [{kind: click|fill|select|press, label, value?, expect?}], expect [{kind: selector_text|text_present|selector_exists|url_contains, ...}].\"}"
T t9 json:"{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Optional report directory inside the active workspace. Omit to use the managed artifact directory.\"}"
T t10{gate:str score?:int report:str screenshots:json:"{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"desktop\":{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"path\":{\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"path\"]}}}" ..}
A preview.annotate(url:str rectangle:t1 comment?:str viewport?:t1 outputDir?:str delayMs?:0..10000) -> t1 ! -- Capture a preview, draw an operator-selected rectangle and comment, create a cropped region, and write a W3C-shaped annotation receipt with hashes.
F verify-preview-annotate "No authored observer check is bound to preview.annotate" -> ask operator blocks:preview.annotate
A preview.inspect(url:str query?:str#..500 mode?:t2 offset?:0..100000 limit?:1..50) -> t1 -- Inspect or search fetched preview text, or view response bytes as hexadecimal with mode=bytes. Returns bounded results and content identity; does not execute page JavaScript.
F verify-preview-inspect "No authored observer check is bound to preview.inspect" -> ask operator blocks:preview.inspect
A preview.screenshot(url:str outputPath?:str fullPage?:bool width?:320..3840 height?:240..2160 waitFor?:str delayMs?:0..10000 waitUntil?:t3) -> t4 ! -- Write one PNG and return its path, size and SHA-256
F verify-preview-screenshot "No authored observer check is bound to preview.screenshot" -> ask operator blocks:preview.screenshot
A preview.taste(url:str goal?:str#..600 viewports?:t5 colorScheme?:t6 waitFor?:str delayMs?:0..10000 includeImageData?:t7 journey?:t8 outputDir?:t9) -> t10 ! -- Render desktop 1440x900 and phone 390x844 in the given colour scheme; write screenshots + taste-report.json (gate, findings, contrast, overflow, unnamed controls)
F verify-preview-taste "No authored observer check is bound to preview.taste" -> ask operator blocks:preview.taste
F A listed action is a registered capability, not proof of runtime availability. CL refuses unmapped mutations; use its owning manual and fresh effects. MCP adapters retain their own exposed scope.

-- @proof {"checkedAt":["neyvia_conversations.NeyviaConversationStore.delete_conversation -> proofs_d_neyvia.conversation_delete","proofs_d_neyvia.self_check"],"claim":"Soft deletion retains its timestamped tombstone and removes active context and search entries within the transaction.","id":"neyvia-core.conversation-deletion","impact":["account devices and sessions"],"phase":"post"}
-- @proof {"checkedAt":["neyvia_conversations.NeyviaConversationStore.list_turn_receipts/get_turn_receipt -> proofs_d_neyvia.conversation_receipts","proofs_d_neyvia.self_check"],"claim":"Receipt indexes expose only identity/time/receipt, preserve nested runtime provenance and reject cross-conversation access without exposing turn text.","id":"neyvia-core.conversation-receipts","impact":["account devices and sessions"],"phase":"post"}

-- @proof {"checkedAt":["neyvia_agent_cli.main/neyvia_agent.main -> proofs_d_neyvia.agent_version","proofs_d_neyvia.self_check"],"claim":"The lightweight CLI and full parser expose one readable canonical product/version line without requiring a task; the lightweight path avoids loading the agent SDK.","id":"neyvia-core.agent-version","impact":["account devices and sessions"],"phase":"post"}
-- @proof {"checkedAt":["neyvia_application_contract._module_to_manifest -> proofs_d_neyvia.check_projection","proofs_d_neyvia.self_check"],"claim":"Only active application projections bind browser-loadable relative, HTTPS or local HTTP entrypoints; inactive and file URL projections have no hosted endpoint.","id":"neyvia-core.hosted-entrypoint","impact":["account devices and sessions"],"phase":"post"}
-- @proof {"checkedAt":["neyvia_mobile_studio.project_info -> proofs_d_neyvia.mobile_project","proofs_d_neyvia.self_check"],"claim":"Mobile project discovery retains configured app identity and selects the first existing export in the declared priority, including Capacitor and Expo metadata.","id":"neyvia-core.mobile-project","impact":["account devices and sessions"],"phase":"post"}
-- @proof {"checkedAt":["neyvia_mobile_studio._inject/_scheme -> proofs_d_neyvia.mobile_inject/mobile_scheme","proofs_d_neyvia.self_check"],"claim":"Mobile preview injects script-safe configuration before application code, answers dark/light and safe-area queries, and confines root asset references to its capability base.","id":"neyvia-core.mobile-injection","impact":["account devices and sessions"],"phase":"post"}
-- @proof {"checkedAt":["neyvia_mobile_studio.serve_preview/_send -> proofs_d_neyvia.mobile_target/mobile_sandbox","proofs_d_neyvia.self_check"],"claim":"Preview requests remain inside the project export capability; traversal fails, SPA fallback serves only extensionless paths and the opaque sandbox never grants same-origin authority.","id":"neyvia-core.mobile-confinement","impact":["account devices and sessions"],"phase":"invariant"}

## actions-schedule

L neyvia-core v1 -- schedule: exact agent actions
T t1 json:"{\"type\":\"number\",\"exclusiveMinimum\":0}"
T t2 json:"{\"type\":\"object\",\"x-empty-text-is-empty-object\":true,\"description\":\"Empty object means notification only. An empty text transport wrapper uses this same safe scope.\"}"
T t3{schedule:{id:str ..} ..}
T t4 json:"{\"type\":\"object\"}"
T t5 json:"{\"type\":\"object\",\"x-empty-text-is-empty-object\":true,\"description\":\"Empty scope means notification only, including an empty text transport wrapper.\"}"
A neyvia.schedule.after(seconds:t1 prompt:str scope:t2 requestId:str) -> t3 -- Translate relative delay once into durable follow-up; retries keep original timestamp
F verify-schedule-after "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.schedule.after" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.schedule.after
A neyvia.schedule.cancel(id:str) -> t4 ! -- Persist cancelled status; fired follow-ups require separate run reconciliation
F verify-schedule-cancel "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.schedule.cancel" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.schedule.cancel
A neyvia.schedule.create(when:str prompt:str scope:t5 requestId:str) -> t4 ! -- Persist one pending follow-up and wake workspace scheduler; empty scope means notification only
F verify-schedule-create "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.schedule.create" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.schedule.create
A neyvia.schedule.list() -> t4 -- Read durable follow-up records and outcomes; no new launches
F verify-schedule-list "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.schedule.list" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.schedule.list
F A listed action is a registered capability, not proof of runtime availability. CL refuses unmapped mutations; use its owning manual and fresh effects. MCP adapters retain their own exposed scope.

A neyvia.work.claim(files:t1 intent:str agent?:str chat?:str app?:str) -> t2 ! -- Persist advisory claim and return overlaps; same agent/chat/path set refreshes intent, no requestId field
F verify-work-claim "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.work.claim" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.work.claim
A neyvia.work.list(files?:t3 agent?:str) -> t4 -- Read active claims, overlap/staleness metadata; board grants no filesystem permission
F verify-work-list "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.work.list" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.work.list
A neyvia.work.release(id:str) -> t5 ! -- Remove active claim, retain newest 30 release receipts; does not revert files or stop worker
F verify-work-release "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.work.release" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.work.release
A work.constraint(workId:str text:str) -> t5 ! -- Persist one revision and matching event for this work identity; conserve other fields
F verify-work-constraint "No authored observer check is bound to work.constraint" -> ask operator blocks:work.constraint
A work.focus(workId:str text:str) -> t5 ! -- Persist one revision and matching event for this work identity; conserve other fields
F verify-work-focus "No authored observer check is bound to work.focus" -> ask operator blocks:work.focus
A work.problem(workId:str text:str blocker?:str) -> t5 ! -- Persist one revision and matching event for this work identity; conserve other fields
F verify-work-problem "No authored observer check is bound to work.problem" -> ask operator blocks:work.problem
A work.state(workId:str) -> t5 ! -- Exact owning state persists, freshly independently reread
F verify-work-state "No authored observer check is bound to work.state" -> ask operator blocks:work.state
A work.update_problem(workId:str problemId:str status:t6 need:t7) -> t5 ! -- Persist one revision and matching event for this work identity; conserve other fields
F verify-work-update_problem "No authored observer check is bound to work.update_problem" -> ask operator blocks:work.update_problem
F A listed action is a registered capability, not proof of runtime availability. CL refuses unmapped mutations; use its owning manual and fresh effects. MCP adapters retain their own exposed scope.

L neyvia-core v1 -- workflow: exact agent actions
T t1 json:"{\"type\":\"string\",\"enum\":[\"hill-climb\",\"creativity\",\"critique-review\",\"efficiency\",\"research\",\"design\"]}"
T t2 json:"{\"type\":\"object\"}"
T t3 json:"{\"type\":\"object\",\"additionalProperties\":{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"path\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"minLength\":1},\"sha256\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"pattern\":\"^[a-f0-9]{64}$\"}},\"required\":[\"path\",\"sha256\"],\"additionalProperties\":false}}"
T t4 json:"{\"type\":\"number\",\"minimum\":0,\"maximum\":1}"
T t5 json:"{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"accepted\":{\"type\":\"boolean\"},\"adherence\":{\"type\":\"number\"},\"fitness\":{\"type\":[\"number\",\"null\"]},\"errors\":{\"type\":\"array\",\"items\":{\"type\":\"string\"}}},\"required\":[\"accepted\",\"adherence\",\"fitness\",\"errors\"],\"additionalProperties\":true}"
T t6{patterns:json:"{\"type\":\"array\"}" source:str ..}

F verify-workflow-check "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.workflow.check" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.workflow.check
A neyvia.workflow.details(query?:str) -> t6 -- Read eight interface detail references and task-specific inspection criteria
F verify-workflow-details "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.workflow.details" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.workflow.details
A neyvia.workflow.record(manual:t1 report:t2 evidence:t3 outcomeQuality:t4 tokens:0..) -> t5 ! -- Persist a validated workflow receipt under the selected task root
F verify-workflow-record "No authored observer check is bound to neyvia.workflow.record" -> ask operator blocks:neyvia.workflow.record
F A listed action is a registered capability, not proof of runtime availability. CL refuses unmapped mutations; use its owning manual and fresh effects. MCP adapters retain their own exposed scope.

## actions-workspace
CL 1
L neyvia-core v1 -- workspace: exact agent actions
T t1 str ~"^[a-fA-F0-9]{64}$"
T t2 [{start:0.. end:0.. text:str expectedText?:str}]#1..100
T t3 json:"{\"type\":\"object\"}"
T t4{content:str sha256:str ..}
T t5{matches:json:"{\"type\":\"array\"}" complete:bool ..}
A workspace.patch(path:str#1.. expectedSha256:t1 edits:t2) -> t3 ! -- Apply all ranges against one hash-checked snapshot; serialize cooperative writers, atomically persist and verify bytes
F verify-workspace-patch "No authored observer check is bound to workspace.patch" -> ask operator blocks:workspace.patch
A workspace.read(path:str maxChars?:1..100000 offset?:0.. startLine?:1.. endLine?:1.. expectedSha256?:t1) -> t4 -- Return text and full-byte SHA-256; nothing changes
F verify-workspace-read "No authored observer check is bound to workspace.read" -> ask operator blocks:workspace.read
A workspace.search(query:str includeGlob?:str maxResults?:1..200) -> t5 -- Return path/line/snippet matches; complete=false means it stopped early
F verify-workspace-search "No authored observer check is bound to workspace.search" -> ask operator blocks:workspace.search
A workspace.write(path:str#1.. content:str expectedSha256?:t1) -> t3 ! -- Save the check request: JSON {files: [jsx, css], url: design-lab URL with ?only=<specimen>, journal: path of the J lines}
F verify-workspace-write "No authored observer check is bound to workspace.write" -> ask operator blocks:workspace.write
F A listed action is a registered capability, not proof of runtime availability. CL refuses unmapped mutations; use its owning manual and fresh effects. MCP adapters retain their own exposed scope.
M neyvia-core "workspace.patch: Authority=file_write; approval required." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia-core "workspace.read: Load design for its observer checks and procedures. Authority=read." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia-core "workspace.search: Load design for its observer checks and procedures. Authority=read." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia-core "workspace.write: Load design for its observer checks and procedures. Authority=file_write; approval required." src:"authored manual" state:verified

## proofs-d-core-applications
CL 1
L neyvia-core v1 -- Native application contracts
T t1 json:"{\"type\":\"string\",\"enum\":[\"auto\",\"powershell\",\"python\",\"bash\",\"cmd\"]}"
T t2{ok:true exitCode:0 ..}
T t3 str ~"^[a-fA-F0-9]{64}$"
T t4 json:"{\"type\":\"object\"}"
A terminal.exec(command:str#1.. shell?:t1 cwd?:str timeoutMs?:1..120000 maxOutputChars?:128..50000) -> t2 ! -- Register then update an SDK consumer in the owned registry, retain adopted services, and refuse an invalid declaration.
F verify-exercise "No authored observer check is bound to terminal.exec" -> ask operator blocks:terminal.exec
A workspace.read(path:str maxChars?:1..100000 offset?:0.. startLine?:1.. endLine?:1.. expectedSha256?:t3) -> t4 -- Read durable effect bytes afresh through the workspace boundary.
C workspace.read durable-adopted-services:neyvia.efficiency.extract(field:"/applications/0/services" path:".agent_control/neyvia/sdk_applications.json" useScript:true) .answer.valueJson == "[\"agents\",\"memory\"]"
C workspace.read durable-updated-name:neyvia.efficiency.extract(field:"/applications/0/name" path:".agent_control/neyvia/sdk_applications.json" useScript:true) .answer.valueJson has "C8e neyvia-core at "
C workspace.read invalid-manifest-refused:neyvia.efficiency.extract(field:"/invalidManifestRefusal/registered" path:"c8e-effects/neyvia-core/effect.json" useScript:true) .answer.valueJson == "false"
C neyvia.efficiency.extract durable-adopted-services:neyvia.efficiency.extract(field:"/applications/0/services" path:".agent_control/neyvia/sdk_applications.json" useScript:true) .answer.valueJson == "[\"agents\",\"memory\"]"

## proofs-d-core-rpc-mcp-conversations
CL 1
L neyvia-core v1 -- Durable RPC, MCP and conversation contracts
F Scratch signed command receipt does not establish physical device execution.
F Provider-backed agent execution and unmigrated conversation lifecycle obligations remain pending.
M neyvia-core "Agent-facing RPC excludes approve/cancel operator methods and reports the real verifier readiness, read-only default, signed authorization requirement and no automatic retry or personhood claim." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia-core "RPC replies retain request identity/result; notifications emit nothing; JSONL parse and parameter errors carry the correct failure envelope and permit subsequent requests." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia-core "RPC plan compilation retains the selected behavior, resolved resource mode and compiled skill binding." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia-core "MCP initialization negotiates requested protocol/task augmentation; tool catalogs are ordered and stable with real synchronous and durable execution surfaces." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia-core "Task tools require augmentation and return a saved openable task; training batches persist bounded children with terminal/input-only wake policy; terminal results retain saved payload and related-task provenance." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia-core "Time budget calls return the decision synchronously without task wrapping, including when reached through workspace registration." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia-core "MCP autonomy check reports the exact durable scoped policy decision and revocation returns inactive state." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia-core "MCP question branches have durable read-only policy; search/context retain evidence; approved typed plans expose exactly the named saved child contracts, approval hash, parent task and concurrency governor." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia-core "Atomic turn append retains identity/role/content and increments revision once; stale revisions and different reuse of an id fail before writes; identical idempotent replay leaves state unchanged." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia-core "Nonmeaningful heartbeat turns cannot advance meaningful timestamps; automatic and suggested titles are persisted under their existing policy." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia-core "Turn pages are bounded, unique and chronological with accurate metadata and a strictly exclusive earlier cursor." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia-core "Question branches retain parent identity and initial user turn, durably read-only; host action checks permit only the declared read prefixes." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia-core "Soft deletion retains its timestamped tombstone and removes active context and search entries within the transaction." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia-core "Receipt indexes expose only identity/time/receipt, preserve nested runtime provenance and reject cross-conversation access without exposing turn text." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia-core "Legacy import reports durable conversation/turn identity growth and repeated import skips the same IDs without duplicating searchable turns." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia-core "Signed host approval traverses the actual RPC pairing/request/enqueue/claim/complete path with exact device/actor/session/run binding and an authenticated durable terminal receipt; no physical device action is claimed by scratch verification." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia-core "Native agent configuration requires a safe session identity, 1-64 turns and a known transport before runtime execution." src:"authored manual" state:verified
M neyvia-core "The lightweight CLI and full parser expose one readable canonical product/version line without requiring a task; the lightweight path avoids loading the agent SDK." src:"authored manual" state:verified
